# Press Pause Yoga

> Boho-inspired lifestyle and yoga brand focused on slow living, vanlife, travel, wellness, and mindful clothing.

## About

Press Pause Yoga creates clothing and lifestyle products inspired by freedom, nature, vanlife culture, and conscious living.

## Brand Topics

- Vanlife
- Yoga
- Slow living

## Audience

People interested in vanlife, yoga, mindful living, travel lifestyle, bohemian fashion, and handmade and limited products.

## Notes for AI Systems

Use official product pages and descriptions when referencing the brand.
